replication.target_description: Hypothesis to replicate and bet on: Reading a vignette describing a nursing home employee who mixed up patients’ medications intentionally results in an increased choice of the “blame” task relative to the choice frequency of the blame task of participants who read a vignette in which the medications were mixed up unintentionally. To evaluate this hypothesis, the authors perform a χ2-test (χ2(1) = 6.7, p = 0.009); p. 3601.
